en: "The Rheinmetall army..."
"We stop in town to resupply and{n} stumble on a pack of rabble not{n} even worth the credit... huh."
"Shall we attack?"
"Good grief, they don't even look{n} like regulars. Mop them up with the{n} Voids. Just don't waste ammo..."
"Yes, sir!"
"Heh heh. Which of us is the rabble..."
"Hmph! Say that after you've{n} broken through the ring of{n} Voids we command, boy!"
"Special Service Second Lieutenant{n} {hero:6}, shall we attack?"
"They're just the right opponent{n} for seeing what you two can do."
"You're ready for this, I take it?"
"Sir!"
"Of course we are."
"All right, let's begin!"
"To check the terrain and the enemy{n} before a battle, please use{n} 'Check Situation'."
"You can check the terrain and{n} the enemies deployed on it."
"While there, you can target allied{n} Masters with the R1 button and{n} allied Voids with R2."
"To check the enemy, please target{n} them with the L1 and L2 buttons."
"'Victory Conditions' shows the{n} goal for clearing this battle."
"Every battle has a target time{n} set for it."
"Win within the target time and you{n} get a time bonus. Naturally, the{n} shorter the time, the higher the prize."
"Once you're ready for battle,{n} please select 'Start Battle'."
"We operate with 'Free Action'{n} as our basic setting."
"Unless you give us special orders,{n} Lieutenant, we take down enemies{n} in order, starting with the nearest."
"Well, just you watch us!"
"Enemy reinforcements! Two of them!"
"When you want to give us orders,{n} please do so as follows."
"Open the window with the Circle{n} button, then choose who to command{n} under 'Tactics' in the menu."
"Change 'Move Order' to 'Target Here'{n} and you can designate targets{n} for movement and attack."
"Use the Circle button to{n} set the movement route."
"You can bend the route up to twice.{n} The third point you set{n} becomes the final target."
"Set the target on an enemy or chest,{n} or press Circle twice on one spot,{n} and it's final even before the third."
"For move orders, besides the{n} 'Target Here' we just explained,"
"there is 'Free Action', which{n} automatically closes in on and{n} attacks nearby enemies,"
"'Attack in Place', which waits on{n} the spot and attacks only enemies{n} that come near,"
"and 'Standby', which stays put{n} without doing anything, among others."
"'Tactics' has all sorts of{n} other commands as well."
"'Enemy Nearby' decides whether to{n} put attacking or moving first when{n} you run into an enemy on the move."
"'Auto Heal' decides the timing{n} for healing automatically{n} when HP runs low."
"And 'Heal Method' decides the{n} means of that healing, and so on."
"HP recovery is done automatically."
"When someone can't heal themselves,{n} a priest or the like nearby{n} will help them recover."
"Please combine these commands{n} well when you give your orders."
"More enemy reinforcements!"
"Shall we see how the Voids{n} are running, too?"
"A Void basically copies{n} the actions of its Master."
"In other words, it moves toward{n} its Master's move target and{n} attacks its Master's attack target."
"You can also give movement{n} orders to a Void directly."
"Put the cursor on the Void and{n} set a move target, the same{n} way you do for us."
"Oho? I see. So you do know how{n} to handle a Void, more or less."
"The Voids we have right now{n} are capable of ranged attacks,"
"but by buying the parts sold at{n} the Void seller's in town and{n} swapping out the arms and legs,"
"you can customize them in all{n} sorts of ways, such as rebuilding one{n} into a high-defense, close-combat Void."
"Holding off approaching enemies{n} with a high-defense Void,"
"whittling down the enemy's strength{n} with a Void that attacks at range..."
"With Master and Void working{n} together, all sorts of tactics{n} are conceivable."
"More enemy reinforcements!"
"How about we take that lot{n} down with a skill!"
"Please choose 'Range Plus'{n} from Griffith's 'Skills'."
"The attack range will be shown, so{n} put the cursor on an enemy inside it{n} and confirm with the Circle button."
"Using a skill requires{n} spirit points (SP)."
"SP builds up as time passes."
"In other words, to use a powerful{n} skill, you have to store up SP{n} for a long time."
"The yellow gauge in the sub-window{n} at the bottom of the screen{n} is your current SP."
"Again...?{n} Persistent bunch."
"Lieutenant {hero:6},{n} your orders, please."
"Let's wipe them out in a flash{n} and move on, shall we!"
"All right, let's go!"
"Our Rheinmetall unit's encirclement..."
"You bastards... you're no... mere rabble!"
"All right, that's enough.{n} Seems you can handle yourselves a little."
"At this rate, I can trust you more{n} than the last batch of replacements."
"But don't let your guard down.{n} Our goal isn't beating gutless{n} enemies like those just now."
"It's getting our hands on this{n} so-called treasure sleeping{n} somewhere on the island."
"And to do that, I don't care{n} what means we use."
"Just survive, and keep moving forward."
"Sir!"
"Sir!"
"Heh. What a worthless bunch.{n} I told you, didn't I? You're{n} the real rabble here..."
"Still..."
"What is it, Lieutenant, sir?"
"The enemy's Voids seem to be{n} getting stronger by the day..."
"Void ore processing has come a long{n} way lately, and every country is{n} pushing ahead on new models."
"Voids even more powerful than these{n} will keep turning up, I expect."
"Void ore..."
"The stone that forms a Void's core..."
"Our country has deposits too, but{n} I hear the most is mined in the{n} Holy Nation of Assyria to the south."
"By one account, Void ore deposits{n} are mostly found on old battlefields."
"How ironic. In ground where so many{n} died, an unknown ore is dug up{n} to make new tools for killing..."
"But you have a Knight's swordsmanship,{n} Lieutenant {hero:6}!"
"You should be more than able to{n} beat the enemy without any Void!"
"A Knight, huh..."
"It's an outdated killing sword,{n} when all's said and done."
"Or maybe a sword of madness{n} that kills even its comrades."
"But that's...!?"
"Today's battlefield isn't about personal{n} skill. Guns, and the specs and numbers{n} of Voids: that all but decides who wins."
"Well, whatever. Let's eat."
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"So strong! They're waaay too strong!?"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"Tch, not bad!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Mm...{n} ...Support...!"
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Gh...{w:1} Why...{w:1} Me, of all people..."
"I'm sorry...{w:1} Hector..."
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Defeat...{n} {w:3}Withdrawing..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
